title: qlinter configuration
description: qlinter.toml and .qlinter.toml: which rules report on q source, and how. qlinter refuses any key not listed here.

selectors.description: Rule codes or prefixes (`QS`, `QF016`), or `ALL`. One that names no rule is refused.

perFileIgnores.description: Glob = [codes]: rules that do not report on the files the glob matches. A leading `!` negates the glob.

severity.description: How a rule's findings are reported, by code or prefix; the longest that names a rule decides. Only an error or a warning fails the run. An editor's own q-lint.lint.severity overrides it for that user.

rules.description: A rule's own options, for the rules that have them. An unknown option is refused.

max-lines.description: Lines of code a lambda may have before QS006 reports it.

markers.description: The words in a comment QL001 reports as unfinished work.

name-pattern.description: A case-insensitive regular expression the last part of a name must match for QX002 to read its string as a credential.

profile.description: The rules reported when nothing selects them: general, style, styleq or uqf, each a superset of the one before.

exclude.description: Files and directories not linted, relative to this file; a pattern with no `/` matches a name at any depth. Replaces the default list.

extend-exclude.description: Added to `exclude`, or to its default list.

extend.description: Another configuration to inherit, relative to this file; what this file sets overrides it.

target-version.description: The q release the QK rules report what does not run on.

baseline.description: A findings file, relative to this file: only findings not in it are reported.

required-version.description: The qlinter releases this repository is linted with, such as ">=0.33, <0.34"; any other refuses to run.

lint.description: The rule-selection keys, which may go here instead of at the top level (not both).
